---
title: "Failure analyses"
---

No experimental failure analysis exists because no experiment has run.

Future entries will distinguish:

- infrastructure-invalid runs;
- contract/schema failures;
- source-parity discrepancies;
- null or negative scientific outcomes;
- safety or authorization stops; and
- retracted interpretations.

Each entry must identify the root cause, affected evidence, corrective action, and whether rerun is permitted. A dependency error is not a negative model result.
